pages.text: $(italic)Ranged investment. Best for Ranger, Samurai.$()$(br2)Arrow damage, draw speed, and ammo efficiency are attribute-based and apply immediately. Ammo save and AoE splash require KubeJS event hooks (Phase 2 — partially implemented).

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Arrow Damage$() — Core trunk via attributeslib:arrow_damage. Scales cleanly with Ranger's Eagle Eye passive.$(br2)$(bold)Draw Speed$() — Reduces bow charge time. At max investment: bows are nearly instant draw.$(br2)$(bold)Precision Branch$() — Reduces arrow spread, increases effective range. Ideal for long-range Ranger play.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Barrage Branch$() — Increases arrow count per shot (multishot-style) and adds small AoE on impact. KubeJS-dependent.$(br2)$(bold)Marksman Capstone$() — $(bold)True Shot$() — Fully charged shots always crit. Crits deal +50% damage instead of +50% vanilla crit.
